items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure or release; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release approvals, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, TLS coverage, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS posture is unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: maintain private launch gates, continue bounded read-only evidence capture, and permit only reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, data boundaries, credentials, permissions, dependencies, and cross-site isolation. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or claim certification.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for access boundaries, secret handling, runtime isolation, build and deployment provenance, dependency and supply-chain controls, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incidents, and disclosure readiness. No new production work, requeues, duplicate telemetry, credential access, permission changes, private-container access, external outreach, or dependency additions are authorized.
